entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I ordered a helmet and... I just need to return it. I'm so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF789012. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and I was really counting on this working out.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Velo-Shield helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's the color. It just wasn't what I expected from the pictures online. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box unopened, still sitting here. I feel so bad about it, but I really needed this money for something else that came up.
I understand completely. It's important that you're happy with your gear, especially something as critical as a helmet. Let me just pull up the return policy for this item.
Okay, I have good news. Since you received the item 10 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return period for standard items. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much.

Of course. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the box and you can drop it off at any courier.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help, Alex. I really appreciate it.
It was my pleasure, Sarah. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
